title: Capstone: find all the problems
summary: A COPD patient over-assisted on PSV (PS 16, ETS 10 %, PEEP 0) with a cuff leak and mobile secretions. Several problems coexist: missed efforts, prolonged insufflations, gas trapping, a leak that the loops betray, and a sawtooth on expiratory flow. Identify every pattern, then fix the settings, the cuff and the airway.
objectives: List every pattern: ineffective efforts, delayed cycling, auto-PEEP, leak and secretions.
Order the fixes: re-inflate the cuff and suction first, then shorten Ti (ETS up, PS down) and offset PEEPi with external PEEP.

fix.note: Cuff re-inflated, suctioned; ETS 70 %, PS 6, PEEP 5, trigger 1.5 L/min.
